## Purpose

Describe the project outcome and affected boundary.

## Safety & release impact
- [ ] No production secret or credential is included.
- [ ] Deployment-trigger branch impact is understood.
- [ ] Database/schema changes include migration and rollback evidence where applicable.
- [ ] No direct production activation is implied by merge unless separately approved.

## Verification
- [ ] Required CI/security checks pass on the exact candidate SHA.
- [ ] Relevant integration/UI tests pass.
- [ ] Rollback path is documented for release-affecting changes.

## Release
- [ ] This PR is development/integration only, or
- [ ] A separate production release approval exists.
